name: living-worlds
description: Walk-in 3D worlds of real places, built from open Earth data

plugins.name: living-worlds
plugins.description: A render_world MCP tool that builds a 3D world of any place (lidar ground and trees where the US has flown a survey, the place's own species, birds with their own voices, buildings, waterfalls, a sound mix) as one HTML file, a living-world skill that studies the place first, and the Maps gallery. Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Pairs with the groundstation plugin.
